releases.name: v5.3.0
highlights: fix: Zigbee2MQTT serial port mismatch inside container (#3204)
fix: battery warning toggle and battery / backup failure messages
fix: poll discovered external devices with a poll_frequency (#3198)

releases.name: v5.2.1
highlights: fix(users): an instance always keeps an administrator

releases.name: v5.2.0
highlights: fix: honor return_url after local login (#3152)
fix(external-integration): accept decimal values in number fields
fix: keep primary, active and danger widget button styles in dark mode (#3153)

releases.name: v5.1.4
highlights: Fix CalDAV sync when event properties have parameters
Limit stored messages to the 1000 most recent per user in the daily purge
fix(caldav): handle "GMT+hhmm" timezones and skip unformattable events (#3144)

releases.name: v5.1.3
highlights: Raise the verbose device threshold and restyle the banner button

releases.name: v5.1.2
highlights: Report the real Docker error when the Gladys upgrade cannot download the image
Add maintainer governance: CODEOWNERS, MAINTAINERS.md and split release workflows
Restrict user location and presence routes to the user themselves or an admin

releases.name: v5.1.1
highlights: ci: replace removed cloudflare/pages-action with wrangler-action
fix(external-integration): make registerProxyService idempotent

releases.name: v5.1.0
highlights: Publish each release to Gladys Plus from the release workflow
docs: recommend linking the forum topic or GitHub issue in pull requests
docs(api): publish the endpoints missing from the generated apidoc

releases.name: v5.0.4
highlights: fix(zigbee2mqtt): support the ConBee III and its 115200 baudrate
Add cursor: pointer to all switch-indicators
fix(dashboard): wrap long text values instead of overflowing the card

releases.name: v5.0.3
highlights: fix(dashboard): compact the shutter buttons into icons in narrow cards
fix(dashboard): round displayed sensor values without losing small-value meaning

releases.name: v5.0.2
highlights: fix(mqtt): subscribe to the custom topics of devices when connecting to the broker
fix(gateway): allow non-admin users to read the Gladys Plus status
fix(dashboard): stop truncating long MQTT device names in the devices widget

releases.name: v5.0.1
highlights: fix(front): paint the Horizon scene on a fixed layer to stop dashboard scroll lag
fix(front): keep the mobile dashboard overflow menu inside the screen
Gladys Plus: warn when the local instance is behind the hosted front
